messages:
Priya N.: quick one — customers reporting spikes of 429s this morning even though per-route dashboard shows room in the route bucket. suspecting quota-bucket assignment lag during rollout of the new routing policy. anyone seen this pattern?

Carlos M.: saw something similar in prod on friday for /v1/embeddings. logs show 429 with body: 

Carlos M.: ```json
{
  "error": "rate_limited",
  "message": "quota exceeded",
  "hint": "bucket mismatch"
}
```

Jordan K.: interesting. do the 429 responses include Retry-After or any quota headers? if not, clients can't fallback.

Carlos M.: most had `Retry-After: 1` but no bucket header. some had `X-Quota-Bucket: route/abc123` while others only had `X-Global-Bucket`. inconsistent.

Maya S.: that smells like the routing change — requests started hitting the new per-route allocator but the quota reconciler hadn't synced bucket ids. We added a short TTL cache for bucket mapping in the runtime last week.

Priya N.: ok. action items: (1) add more explicit bucket header on 429s (both `X-RateLimit-Bucket` and `X-Global-Bucket` for now), (2) make SDKs prefer `Retry-After` but fallback to `X-RateLimit-Reset` if present, (3) add telemetry span to surface bucket assignment time during rollout. thoughts?

Jordan K.: +1 on doubling headers for backward compat. but avoid breaking clients that parse the body. suggest we put bucket id in body hint too: `{ hint: "bucket: route/abc123" }` so older clients at least log it.

Maya S.: implemented a quick change to include `X-RateLimit-Bucket` on 429 responses in a canary build. pushed to canary cluster at 10:30. monitoring now.

ratebot: Deploy: canary cluster -> runtime-service v3.2.8 (sha: a5f4e3) — started at 2026-03-17T10:30:12Z.

Carlos M.: can we also surface a soft-signal header for approximate remaining capacity e.g. `X-Quota-Estimate: 120` (units = requests)? would help client-sided smoothing.

Priya N.: good idea. but keep it best-effort and clearly documented as advisory (not authoritative). need product sign-off for public docs.

Maya S.: I'll add `X-Quota-Estimate` to canary too (value is from allocator heuristics). will tag it `advisory` in header docs.

Jordan K.: SDK checklist for backcompat: parse `Retry-After` -> fallback to `X-RateLimit-Reset` -> fallback to `X-Quota-Estimate` -> finally exponential backoff. add a metric when clients use header fallbacks so we can see adoption.

Priya N.: sounds good. i'll open a short RFC + rollout plan (will include header names, body hint, and telemetry + docs changes). ETA EOD.

Carlos M.: ping me on the RFC for verbiage around `advisory` vs `contract` for `X-Quota-Estimate`. i can help.

Maya S.: monitoring update: after canary push, 429 rate on canary dropped ~40% in the last 10m because clients picked up header and retried slower. still watching. :eyes:

Priya N.: awesome — thanks. if canary looks stable by noon, let's schedule a gradual rollout and a short burst window where we keep global fallback enabled.

Jordan K.: will add a lint rule to server side that prevents emitting 429 without either `Retry-After` or `X-RateLimit-Bucket` — catches regressions.

Priya N.: perfect. I'll post the RFC link here when it's up. :thumbsup:
